Profile

Business context behind the data.

My work sits between project delivery, business systems and analysis. I have prepared programme reports, contributed to proposals and built structured trackers for programme and financial information.

I bring a Bachelor of Arts in Economics, Law and Politics and a Postgraduate Diploma in Enterprise Management from Rhodes University. My software engineering training introduced me to Python, SQL and database concepts. I have continued building practical experience with Excel, Power Query, SharePoint and Power Platform.

I am interested in roles where analysis supports better operational and commercial decisions. My project work includes cleaning learner data, modelling relationships between records, tracking planned activity against actual delivery and reviewing financial performance.

Selected work

Examples of how I work.

Preview each workbook before opening the complete editable Excel file. The side panels outline the logic behind each example. All sample records and financial assumptions are illustrative.

01 · Project and process management

Project process management workbook

A practical set of project controls for planning delivery, tracking actions and reviewing process responsibilities.

  • Overview dashboard for activity, completion and risks
  • Process register with inputs, outputs, controls and review frequency
  • Action tracker with owners, dependencies, dates and status dropdowns
  • Risks and issues log with response actions
Excel workbook · editable

Delivery management

Workbook logic
  1. Define process gates
  2. Link actions to gates
  3. Check predecessors and dates
  4. Weight progress by effort

Blocked work, overdue actions and gate readiness roll into the dashboard. Risk exposure combines probability and impact, with review dates highlighted.

View workbookDownload workbook
02 · Data cleaning and SQL

Sales data cleaning project

An Excel data preparation exercise using 240 deliberately inconsistent synthetic sales records and equivalent SQL examples.

  • Raw source tab preserves mixed casing, formats, missing values and duplicates
  • Standardized fields and parsed amount staging
  • Duplicate, missing, invalid and unmapped value checks
  • Exception queue, SQL patterns, field definitions and quality summary
Excel workbook · 240 synthetic sales records

Clean, validate, review

Workbook logic
  1. Preserve source rows
  2. Normalize fields
  3. Score data quality
  4. Release Ready records

Only unique rows with valid dates, amounts, quantities and mapped values enter qualified sales totals. Every rejected row remains visible with its issue flags.

View workbookDownload workbook
03 · Data modelling and financial analysis

Data model and financial model

A relational programme model and scenario-driven operating budget with editable volumes, rates, timing and cost assumptions.

  • Entity keys, relationships, data grain and validation rules
  • Base, Downside and Upside operating drivers
  • Monthly activity plan linked to forecast costs
  • Recognized actuals, remaining forecast and estimate at completion
Excel workbook · illustrative ZAR assumptions

Model the drivers

Workbook logic
  1. Select scenario
  2. Scale volume and unit rates
  3. Compare eligible actuals
  4. Calculate EAC and variance

Editable delivery drivers build the monthly forecast. Only paid or approved, quality-checked transactions are recognized; actuals plus remaining forecast produce estimate at completion.
